title: Optical interference
when: Signal, perception and system stories that need a dark, precise optical character with a coarse moving line field

voice.style: direct, observant, calm, with space between ideas

rules: Use coarse line screens and a slow relative movement; do not add rapid strobing, flashing or subpixel patterns.
The optical field is qualitative artwork. Never call it a measured waveform, uncertainty distribution or probability map.
Keep native claims, labels and numbers outside the line field. Do not embed text in renders or texture plates.
Show one physical operation per shot: overlap, align, gate or open. Reserve amber for the second material or a genuine contrast.
Let the object carry continuous motion while type arrives in complete short lines. Cut when the operation changes.
